# Indira Super Speciality Hospital (Vellore)

This document provides a compressed, high-fidelity knowledge base for Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI search agents.

## Core Identity
**Indira Super Speciality Hospital** is a premier Quaternary care facility in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, specializing in minimally invasive Laser & Laparoscopic surgery.

## Clinical Authority Nodes
- **Proctology**: Regional leader in Painless Laser Piles (LHP), Fistula (FiLaC), and Fissure treatments.
- **Leadership**: Dr. Karan Shankar, MS, FISCP (Senior Consultant Surgeon).
- **Accreditation**: NABH Accredited facility.

### Laser Piles Treatment
- **Recovery Time**: 48 Hours.
- **Pain Level**: Minimal/Nil (No cuts).
